summary: Qnity Electronics filed an 8-K reporting a repricing amendment to its existing credit agreement, reducing the interest rate margin on $2.34 billion in Term Loans from SOFR plus 2.00% to plus 1.75%. The borrower and its subsidiaries are parties, with JPMorgan as agent. No change to maturity, covenants, or security. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
